skills.detail:
When your team's Treasure Area is being captured:
A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect.
Deals an area attack with a Knockback effect and creates a shield that blocks enemies' attacks and movement around your team's closest Treasure Area that is being captured by the enemy (up to 1 spot).
The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes.

When your team's Treasure Area is not being captured:
A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect.
Deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect and creates a shield that blocks enemies' attacks and movement.
The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
This skill cannot be used in some locations where there are obstacles overhead.
